data.name: 4 Hour Private Tour
data.headline: Boat tours up to 6 people or Groups up to 17 people.
data.description:
Indulge in the ultimate luxury with our private boat tours, where every aspect of your experience is tailored to your desires, designed for unforgettable fun with friends or special celebrations! Cruise the waterways, spy on stunning homes, and jam out to your favorite tunes while soaking up the sun. Want to stop for lunch or a drink at a local water front restaurant, this is the perfect excursion! With options to explore hidden islands, sip cool drinks, and dance to the beat, our private tours promise an exhilarating ride that's totally tailored to your crew's vibe. Get ready to make memories that will last a lifetime!
This is fully customizable for a great day on the water for you and your party.
data.highlights:
Personalized Experience: We tailor every aspect of your tour to your preferences, ensuring a unique and unforgettable experience.
Expert Guidance: Our experienced guides and captains are knowledgeable about the area and will enhance your journey with their insights and stories.
Flexibility: We offer flexible scheduling and customizable itineraries, allowing you to design the perfect outing for your group.
Luxury Amenities: Enjoy the ultimate in comfort and convenience with amenities such as music, and optional stops at hidden islands.
Special Celebrations: Whether it's an anniversary, birthday, or other special occasion, our private tours provide the ideal setting for celebration and making memories.
Capacity: Accommodating parties of up to 17 individuals, our tours are perfect for groups of friends, families, or corporate outings.
Unmatched Service: From start to finish, our team is dedicated to providing exceptional service and ensuring your satisfaction throughout your journey.
data.itinerary:
This is a fully customizable experience! Call our office ahead of time and discuss with them your interests for the excursion. They will assist you in your time booked to create a great experience for you. This will also allow time for the captain to plan your day for a worry free trip!

Popular activities include going to Keywaydin Island, having lunch or a drink from a water front restaurant, stopping on an isolated island, seeing the mansions from the water, finding dolphins, and cruising around Marco Island.

Please understand that if you have special requests, we need to be told in advance. If you wait until you arrive or when you are on tour, you may not get to do the activity you'd like. So be sure to contact the office with your requests so we can plan the boat ride accordingly.
data.group_size: 17 Individuals, infants must weigh 17 lbs or heavier

meeting_point.address: Goodland Boat Park, 750 Palm Point Dr., Goodland, FL 34140

data.what_is_included:
Shell Bags 
Bottled Water
Cooler with ice for guest use
data.what_is_not_included:
Gratuity for your captain and guide not included in price, so please don't forget to tip your crew!
Alcoholic beverages and snacks or food. You are welcome to bring anything you'd like!
Parking Pass at the park. Per Collier County Park rules, if you do not have a Collier County Beach Sticker on your vehicle you must purchase a $10 parking pass.
Snacks are not provided, but you're welcome to bring any food or drinks along with you.
Towels are not included
data.what_to_bring:
Please bring water! 
Shoes you do not mind getting wet, preferably water shoes, flip flops or sandals.
Sunscreen
Hat
Towel
Camera
Sun protective clothing
You are welcome to bring any other beverages, even 21+ drinks are allowed on board the vessels. 
Snacks, breakfast or lunch is welcome on board the vessel as well.
data.cancellation_summary: Customers receive a full refund for cancellations 48 hours before the booking. Cancellations, changes, or no-shows within 48 hours are charged in full. Operator cancellations get a full refund.
data.cancellation_notes: Customers will receive a full refund if they cancel their reservation 48 hours prior to the date and time of their booking, (customers will be charged in full within the 48 hour period before the booking). Changes on your reservation will be received 48 hours in advance, otherwise your will be charged in full for your original booking. Contact us by phone to cancel or inquire about a cancellation. No-shows will be charged the full price. Customers will also receive a full refund in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances.
data.check_in_details:
Guests will need to sign our online waivers before check in. This can be found in the confirmation email. A text the day before or morning of the tour will be sent as a reminder of location and waivers. 

A crew member will be at the park waiting to check in all guests for the scheduled tour. Please look out for our shirts to know who to check in with. 
Once parked and checked in you will be instructed for a parking pass, where the bathroom is, and where to wait before the crew calls for their group. 

Please note that our company waits at the shaded pavilion ONLY for check in. You cannot go down to the docks or any other part of the park to find us. If you do not see our crew, call the office for information and assistance.
data.accessibility: Yes, please note there are 3 steps in and out of the boat from the dock and beach.
data.special_requirements:
Infants must weigh more than 17 lbs to be on board any of our boats per Coast Guard Regulations. If under that weight, they are not allowed on board. 

All minors must be accompanied by an adult.

Service animals and dogs are allowed on the private tours, but please note that the dogs must remain leashed at all times. Dogs are not permitted on the island beaches if they are off leash.
data.restrictions:
Dogs and other animals considered pets are prohibited on the beaches or islands that we visit. Service animals only!

No restrictions, but please consult your doctor if you are pregnant or have medical care needs before booking the tour to ensure your safety. 

Please note that we do have a step stool to get in and out of the boat at the beach. Boat is parked directly on the beach, and it is about 1-3 steps, depending on tide, to get off the boat and back into the boat. A railing is available to help balance.
data.extras:
Life Jackets are available on the vessel, but are not required to be worn for adults or children during the tour. Your captain and crew will happily assist in putting them on or having them out for you per your request.

If you would like beach chairs and umbrellas please contact our office to have these added to your reservation!
data.disclaimers:
Please understand that weather can change at any given moment that could prevent the tour from starting or result in your tour ending early. Our crew is constantly watching the radars to ensure all guests safety, it is their call to bring guests in early due to bad weather conditions.

There is no guarantee to the type of shell or how many you will find during your tour. Our crew assists in looking for shells and will only take you to islands and beaches that have been producing good shells recently. They may even avoid certain spots if too many boats are pulled up. High tides do make it harder to shell so research your days and times ahead of time.

If you or your guests in your party are not being respectful to your captain, guide, or other guests, the captain and guide have the right to return your group back to the dock. NO REFUND will be processed. 

Wildlife sightings can be unpredictable. We never know what the dolphins, birds or other wildlife are doing at any given time of day, or where they are hanging out. As you cruise around the islands, your captain is driving to all the known favorite spots of the dolphins. Sometimes this can take a little bit of time, so please be patient and understanding that your captain and guide are doing their best!
data.faqs:
Are there any restrooms on board the vessel?
No. The public boat marina you meet us for the tour has a public restroom that you can use before and after your tour. Once on the boat, Mother Nature becomes your restroom.

What should we wear? Should we bring bathing suits?
Bathing suits are ideal, but outdoor comfortable wear is perfect! Guests are welcome to swim at the island beach. Just ensure you have comfortable shoes that can get wet to walk along the beaches. If a lot of shells, it can be uncomfortable to walk on.

Are we able to do water sports like wake boarding or fishing?
No. Our boats are not permitted for fishing, and we are not equipped for water sports activities on our vessels. Swimming can be done at any of the island beaches and you are welcome to bring floats and such to use.
